description:
Ideal man vs realistic man! A bank teller named Jin-ah, who had given up on her dream and was torn between ideals and reality at every moment, happens to meet an ideal man 'Hodu Lee' and a realistic man 'Do-Jun' at the point of her new transfer. A growing romance drama centered on 'Jin-ah' between the two so different, what will 'Jin-ah' choose in the future?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B7%B8%EB%85%80%EC%9D%98-%EC%95%B5%EB%AC%B4%EC%83%88/1863), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/60798748)
